1. Colour the three lines menuz's log window leaves plain: "Yes". Filed as 0102 at 566fcfb8, its design for your read before any code: a realise past its cap orange and one that failed red; every line the top row logs red, after a `masthead: ` prefix that MenuzMasthead.row adds; `could not register as a login item` orange; makers in MenuzKit that write today's bytes; menuz 0.4.7. Size M. ic claims it.
2. ic moves arca_swift's own CI to Xcode 27: "Yes". That was done before hv answered: arca_swift's 9c1ebf2 (17:58Z), pushed, run 39827315425 green, both jobs on Xcode 27.1 (27A9275). Nothing is left for ic; the open question was stale.
Asked of vc: your read of 0102's design; then, in Intent's gaps, a heavy slot for R2 and one for G (`menuz test --unsigned` with `utilz test menuz`), and dc's kovacs leg on G's bytes. If 0102 lands before hold 12's install of main, that install carries it and hv's Mac takes one install, not two: your call. intent/wip.md's TODO for the three lines is answered. 0102's point 9 names three more plain lines that say something did not happen (the login shell's capture failing, the menu bar mark missing, notifications denied). They are not hv's three, so not in 0102; put them to hv only if you think it worth asking.
